summary: 5 film announcements, 7 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Stag Dance
film.announcement: Run-A-Muck is developing Torrey Peters' novella 'Stag Dance' for film; the novella was part of the 2026 Pulitzer Prize finalist collection.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.announcement: Coming-of-age drama 'Nice Eggs' stars Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice, directed by Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Touch Grass
film.talent: Dave Clark (director), Brad Miska, Chris White (producers)
film.announcement: Promise AI is developing horror feature 'Touch Grass' with Dave Clark directing and Brad Miska and 'Backrooms' EP Chris White producing.

film.title: Ink
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama 'Ink' starring Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy 'Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint'.

tv.title: Dig
tv.announcement: Peacock sets premiere date for comedy series 'Dig' starring Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie from Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin.

tv.title: Ascension
tv.announcement: Apple TV+ orders Alfonso Cuarón's psychological horror thriller series 'Ascension' starring 'Outlander' alum Caitríona Balfe.

tv.title: Clueless
tv.announcement: Paramount's 'Clueless' series receives California TV tax credit allocation.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green
tv.announcement: Netflix YA hockey drama 'The Sticks' starring Michelle Monaghan confirms additional cast including Scott Bakula and Logan Marshall-Green.

tv.title: Ascent
tv.announcement: Viola Davis' 'Ascent' receives California TV tax credit allocation.

tv.title: Ted Lasso
tv.announcement: Tanya Reynolds joins 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 as a tough and cold women's soccer coach.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Justice Smith cast as Harris Drover in 'Heated Rivalry', promising fans he will 'take good care' of the character.
